output.reason: [ev-be4f90e8abf9] says that in v3 Traefik no longer auto-detects the `Content-Type` header when the backend does not set it, and that the `ContentType` middleware must be used to turn auto-detection back on. The subject and the behavior-changed type are therefore right. However, the proposed before/after values are reworded statements wrapped in extra quote marks, not literal values from the text. They are optional for behavior-changed, so I removed them rather than keep invented literals.

correction.statement: In Traefik v3, the Content-Type header is no longer auto-detected when the backend does not set it; the ContentType middleware must be used to enable Content-Type auto-detection.
